messages:
Amy (AE): Delta wants to run a short POC in our sandbox for a customer-facing assistant. They want to try 'delta-instruct-15b-quant' + a few custom prompts. Can we confirm compatibility and a rough price delta vs vanilla 15b?
Raj (Infra Eng): quick note: quant variant should run but we need to validate KV cache behavior (prefix caching) and dynamic batching. memory footprint ~ 36GB GPU with quant hooks, expect slightly higher latency with batching off.
Amy (AE): they also sent a security questionnaire (SSQ). Deadline EOD Fri for initial answers. Any blockers on answering last-mile infra questions?
Elena (Security): I skimmed SSQ. Main asks: data residency, key management (KMS), audit logs, and model provenance. We can answer with: VPC/private deploy options, KMS/HSM integrations, audit logs via Console, and we can state model provenance if vendor provided artifacts. Need Raj to confirm logs retention defaults.
Raj (Infra Eng): retention defaults: 30d for trace/logs, can extend with Enterprise add-on. Will confirm for sandbox (should be 7d in sandbox).
Theo (Solutions): For compatibility runbook, suggest a 15-minute smoke test script we can hand them. Here is a quick curl to hit sandbox variant:

```bash
curl -X POST https://sandbox.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDWOOD-POC-TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"delta-instruct-15b-quant","prompt":"translate: Hello ->" ,"max_tokens":64}'
```

Theo (Solutions): Also include an adapter test to validate KV cache warmups. Command: `python tools/check_kv_warmup.py --model delta-instruct-15b-quant --seq 512`
Amy (AE): Pricing question from Delta: if they run ~2M tokens/day during POC, and then move to dedicated, what's estimate? Is quant billed differently?
Raj (Infra Eng): tokens billed per platform unit; quant doesn't change token billing. But GPU sizing differs. Rough thumb: hosted quant variant on shared = $0.12 /k token (POC estimate), dedicated commit pricing ~40% lower depending on months. I'll pull accurate numbers from pricing sheet.
Elena (Security): Also: they asked whether model weights are checked for third-party license flags. We do provenance checks on models in our catalog. If Delta wants an attestation, legal will need time.
Amy (AE): Can we get a checklist to answer SSQ quickly? I'm building the response bundle.
Theo (Solutions): I'll prepare a 1-page compatibility note (latency, mem, recommended batch sizes, KV tips) and paste into the SSQ appendix.
Raj (Infra Eng): I'll validate sandbox retention + run the smoke script on our side and paste results. ETA 4pm PT.
Elena (Security): I'll draft security answers for data handling, KMS, audit logs, and add a recommended redaction note for PHI. ETA EOD Thu.
Amy (AE): Great. Delta also asked about model rollbacks: can we pin to older non-quant variant if they see quality regressions?
Raj (Infra Eng): Yes - we can route to an alternative model variant. Routing config looks like: `route: delta-instruct-15b -> fallback: delta-instruct-15b-nonquant` in the policy. No downtime.
Theo (Solutions): I'll share a tiny A/B test litmus: 500 prompts, compare perplexity + human QA. Recommend doing that if they switch to quant.
Amy (AE): Assignments: Theo - compatibility note + scripts. Raj - sandbox smoke + retention confirmation + pricing numbers. Elena - SSQ draft. I'll assemble and send to Delta once we have them.
Raj (Infra Eng): launched quick run now. Reply with output in ~30m.
deploy-bot: sandbox/delta-poc environment provisioned: gpu-1a (A100s), token: REDWOOD-POC-TOKEN, status: ready :rocket:
Amy (AE): awesome :thumbsup: tagging @Delta contact wecc to schedule kickoff after we send SSQ answers.
Theo (Solutions): one more FYI — quant variant exhibits slightly higher EOS jitter on long contexts. We'll note mitigation (shorter chunking + prefix caching).
Amy (AE): Perfect. I'll loop legal if Elena needs the attestation path. Thanks team — I'll post a follow-up once Raj and Elena upload outputs. :calendar:
